sources.snippet: Realistic Vision V6.0 is a fully retrained Stable Diffusion model offering improved photorealistic image generation with 724k training steps on 3400+ images. It supports samplers like DPM SDE++ Karras and Euler A with optimized parameters for quality results. It generates photorealistic images from text prompts, with output dimensions up to 1920×1920 pixels.
